title: Bees for Solby
offer: My apple trees bloom, but no bee visits them! Without bees, no apples. Buy a beehive from Alfhild in Dimmberga and bring it to my orchard.

steps.say: Listen to them hum! Now the flowers will become apples. Take these flowers for your farm.

fact: Bees carry the pollen from flower to flower, so that the fruits grow.
